objectives: This course focuses on applications of numerical models for groundwater flow and transport problems. Students in this class will learn a number of numerical models that are relative to groundwater flow and transport. The procedure to create conceptual model and interpretation of modeling results will be discussed through case studies.
content:
1.地下水水流與污染傳輸理論回顧
2.數值方法之理論回顧
3.地下水數值模式之概念模式建立
4.模擬的物理及數值參數分析以及邊界條件設定
5.案例實習
books:
Anderson M.P. and Woessner W.W, (1992), Applied Groundwater Modeling-Simulation of Flow and Advective Transport, Academic Press.
Wang H.F. and Anderson M.P.(1982), Introduction to Groundwater Modeling, Academic Press.
